lookup_qmof_khot_embedding_by_atomic_num: lookup the 64-dimensional k-hot elemental embedding vector for a given atomic number from the QMOF_KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary
iterate_qmof_khot_embeddings: iterate over all 103 atomic number keys in QMOF_KHOT_EMBEDDINGS to access each element's k-hot embedding vector
check_embedding_dimensionality: check that each embedding vector in QMOF_KHOT_EMBEDDINGS has exactly 64 dimensions
summarize_qmof_khot_embeddings: summarize the QMOF_KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary which maps atomic numbers 1 through 103 to 64-dimensional k-hot feature vectors
review_qmof_khot_embeddings: review the QMOF_KHOT_EMBEDDINGS constant to understand which of the 64 feature dimensions are active for a specific element
